tests.reason: The gateway read gate ships in log mode (vitana-platform part of VTID-05063), so staging still answers 200 and a staging spec cannot produce a 401/403. The behaviour is proven in Vitest: the session bearer is sent on GET /api/v1/tasks, no request is sent when signed out, and 401 and 403 each stop polling and stream reconnects and show the access-denied state.
